preconditions.description: The number of silos n is between 2 and 2000 inclusive.
The number of scout groups k is between 1 and n-1 inclusive.
The number of lines describing the polygon plan is n-1.

preconditions.expression: all(len(droids[i]) == n - i - 1 for i in range(n - 1))
preconditions.description: The i-th line contains n-i-1 integers describing the number of droids on the passages.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= droids[i][j] <= 10**9 for i in range(n - 1) for j in range(n - i - 1))
preconditions.description: Each number of droids ci,j is between -1 and 10^9 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is the integer part of the average danger of all possible ways to choose set S.
